hero.title: General Surgery
hero.excerpt:
The General Surgery Department at Hijaz Hospital provides comprehensive surgical care for patients requiring elective and emergency procedures. Supported by experienced surgeons, anesthetists, nursing staff, and modern operation theatre facilities, the department delivers safe, effective, and patient-centered surgical care using modern surgical techniques and evidence-based practices.

Our team manages a wide range of surgical conditions, from common general surgical procedures to complex gastrointestinal and hepatobiliary surgeries, ensuring quality care before, during, and after surgery.

excerpt: The Orthopedics Department at Hijaz Hospital provides comprehensive diagnosis, treatment, and rehabilitation for disorders and injuries affecting the bones, joints, muscles, ligaments, tendons, and spine.

hero.title: Orthopedics
hero.excerpt:
The Orthopedics Department at Hijaz Hospital provides comprehensive diagnosis, treatment, and rehabilitation for disorders and injuries affecting the bones, joints, muscles, ligaments, tendons, and spine. Supported by experienced orthopedic surgeons, consultants, nursing staff, and rehabilitation professionals, the department offers comprehensive care for patients of all ages, from emergency trauma management to advanced orthopedic surgery and postoperative rehabilitation.

The department provides outpatient consultations, emergency trauma care, elective orthopedic procedures, and rehabilitation services using modern surgical techniques, advanced implants, and dedicated physiotherapy support.

sections.title: Our Orthopedic Services
sections.description: Our department offers a wide range of orthopedic services, including:

items.label: Emergency management of fractures and traumatic injuries
Treatment of congenital and developmental deformities
Correction of neuromuscular and orthopedic disorders
Evaluation and treatment of spinal disorders
Conservative management of back and neck conditions
Surgical treatment for selected spinal fractures and conditions
Treatment of deformities resulting from trauma or congenital conditions
Where appropriate, minimally invasive surgical techniques are used to reduce tissue damage, promote faster recovery, and shorten hospital stays.
Modern operation theatres and advanced surgical equipment
Infection prevention protocols and modern postoperative care
Affordable treatment options with financial assistance for eligible patients

hero.title: Urology
hero.tagline: Comprehensive Care for Urinary Tract & Male Reproductive Disorders
hero.excerpt:
The Urology Department at Hijaz Hospital provides comprehensive diagnosis, treatment, and surgical care for diseases affecting the kidneys, ureters, bladder, urethra, and male reproductive system. Our experienced urologists offer both minimally invasive and open surgical procedures using modern techniques to deliver safe, effective, and patient-centered care.

The department manages a wide range of urological conditions, including urinary stone disease, prostate disorders, urinary tract abnormalities, male reproductive conditions, and urological cancers.
